descriptions.notStarted: You have a very smart pet with you. Please take it to Bartos the pet instructor. With his guidance, the pet may even start a conversation...
descriptions.inProgress: In order to request Bartos for help in teaching the evolving pet new language, I'll need to bring him his favorite drink. The drink can be obtained through merchants.
descriptions.completed: I gave Bartos a drink and taught the evolving pet. Apparently the pet may start the conversation at times...what would it say...?
